If you have to verify lots and lots of UIs, I suggest you do some automation which launches a UI, then runs the needed tests on that UI, then launches a second UI, etc. and leave the machine running overnight.  You could use either the APIs, or the console application.


is the code available for automate AccChecker

thanks ,
Raja Babu nethi

Hello Raja,

 

Apologies for the delayed response.

 

Are you asking whether AccChecker has functionality itself to help with the automation process for launching the UIs?  If so, then the answer is NO – AccChecker can verify the UIs once you launch them, but does not have a mechanism to launch them (such as pre-record a series of steps and then execute them).  That problem is quite complex in and of itself, so we considered it outside the scope of AccChecker.  You will need to find tools that can help you launch the UIs, and then pass the HWND to the AccChecker verifications.

 

Thanks,

 

Peter Lakov

AccChecker Program Manager
